SELECT
  o.opsregistry AS operation_id,
  ROUND((t.totaldeliverytons / NULLIF(h.hubcaptons, 0)) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100.0) * 100, 4) AS performance_efficiency_score,
  CASE
    WHEN t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND h.invaccpct > 95 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS meets_excellence_criteria
FROM operations o
JOIN distributionhubs h ON o.opshubref = h.hubregistry
JOIN transportation t ON t.transporthubref = h.hubregistry
ORDER BY performance_efficiency_score DESC;

args.sql:
SELECT
  o.opsregistry AS operation_id,
  ROUND((t.totaldeliverytons / NULLIF(h.hubcaptons, 0)) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100.0) * 100, 4) AS performance_efficiency_score,
  CASE
    WHEN t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND h.invaccpct > 95 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS meets_excellence_criteria
FROM operations o
JOIN distributionhubs h ON o.opshubref = h.hubregistry
JOIN transportation t ON t.transporthubref = h.hubregistry
ORDER BY performance_efficiency_score DESC;
